name: homebuyer-affordability-check
title: Homebuyer Affordability Check
description: Check the two ratios lenders check first: debt-to-income (DTI) per Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-6-02 (ART-335) and loan-to-value (LTV) per Fannie Mae Selling Guide B2-1.1-03 (ART-336), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). This shows two underwriting ratios, not a promise of approval or denial. Not financial advice.

steps.handoff: Produces front_end_dti_pct and back_end_dti_pct from gross monthly income, housing payment (PITIA), and other monthly debts; classifies the back-end ratio into a DTI tier
Produces ltv_pct, cltv_pct, and hcltv_pct from appraised value, sales price, and lien amounts; applies the lesser-of-value-or-price rule
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)
